title: Community Acquired Pneumonia in Telemark and Ostfold
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the bacterial causes in community acquired pneumonia in adults admitted to hospital in two counties in Norway and to look at possible factors that makes the patients susceptible to pneumonia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Symptoms of lower airway infection and radiologic sings of pneumonia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age\<18
* Serious psychiatric illness
* Mentally retarded
* Hospitalized last 14 days
study_population: Patients admitted to hospital with community acquired pneumonia.
